name: Book of Ascension: a rank below one the character holds is not sold, and the rank sold is announced
contract: A ladder rank the character already holds above a row is not an upgrade: Player::addSpell only moves the spell into the active spec, announces nothing for it, and announces the rank it pulls into the active spec instead - so the window used to sell a rank and name a different one in chat. The window must treat that row as known, and the only cue a granted purchase produces must name the rank that was bought.

steps.label: fixture: a purse deep enough for a ladder
fixture: the tree granted Witchblight's first rank
fixture: the character holds a higher rank of the ladder
the rank under the one the character holds is not offered
the rank above the one it holds is offered
try to buy the closed rank
buy the rank above the one held
and the cue named the rank that was bought
and no cue named another rank
and none named a lower one
